Hello,
We have started releasing the latest update patch to fix the following bugs and improve the stability of the gameplay.
When this patch is applied, the version on the upper right of the title screen will be 1.1.2.
-Three playable characters will be unlocked immediately after the tutorial.
*Please note that this change will result in a loss of consistency with the main storyline.
-Fixed a bug that could cause the number of "Sacred Tree Nut" slots to increase.
-The doors in Stage 8 will now open when attacked.
-The Secret Arts “Rigid Throw,” “Throat Grab,” and “Izuna Drop” will now stagger purple aura zombies.
-Changed the interface when picking up items.
-Adjusted the balance of Raiden (Sumo Wrestler).
-Adjusted the effects of some Charms.
-Adjusted the bosses in "Smoke and Mirrors 1" and "Smoke and Mirrors 2".
-Adjusted the content of "Help" and "Perry's Journal".
-Fixed other minor bugs.

“Ed-0: Zombie Uprising” Patch Notes Version 0.6.0（August 18th, 2022）
Hello,
We have started distributing the latest update patch to add new elements, fix the following bugs, and improve the stability of the gameplay.
When this patch is applied, the version on the upper right of the title screen will be 0.6.0.
Added Ninja “Matoka” as a playable character
Added new item “Dummy Doll”
Added new item “Suzaku Charm”
Added new item “Seiryu Charm”
Added new item “Byakko Charm”
Added new item “Genbu Charm”
Added new item “Trap Disposal Talisman”
Added new additional skill “Effectiveness +” to some of the Secret Arts Upgrade Manuals
Added resuscitation effect by "Life Doll" and "Dummy Doll"
Modified so that number of completions for each quest will be recorded in Hokusai Studio
Modified so that each time an enemy gets the same abnormal condition, the resistance will increase
Modified the icons displayed on the mini-map
Adjusted the behavior of some bosses and enemies
Modified the pedestals of treasure boxes to be destructible
Modified so that there will be a 3-minute time limit on enemy annihilation (Monster House) events
Modified so that street vendor does not attack players at any times except when they steal items from the shop
Adjusted item drops in some of the side-quests
Adjusted the amount of money dropped by enemies
Adjusted trading prices of items
Modified so that the maximum Vitality does not fluctuate when equipping the "Drunkard Charm"
Removed drunkenness prevention effect of the "Drunkard Charm”
Added drunkenness prevention to the effect of the "Clearheaded Charm”
Adjusted the damage notations that sometimes overlapped and were difficult to see
Adjusted the effects of some charms
Adjusted the balance of some side-quests
Restored additional skill “Money Acquisition +” to some of the Secret Arts Upgrade Manuals
Adjusted the initial movement speeds of Samurai and Sumo Wrestler
Improved the appearance of dungeon shops
Adjusted the overall combat balance
Fixed some issues that could cause the game to crash
Fixed a bug that sometime caused Sumo Wrestler to grab zombies and then leave them attached to their hands
Fixed anomalous fall damage determination
Fixed a bug in which the player could become inebriated and unable to act when activating ZEN mode during intoxication status
Fixed an issue where changes to key configurations were not being saved at certain times
Fixed the behavior of some bosses

Fixed other minor bugs: We will continue to update additional elements and make balance adjustments as part of the process of polishing the game, and we really appreciate your continued support and cooperation!!: Team Ed-Zero: Tell us about the game in the official Discord! https://discord.gg/4dMMPXqKV3

“Ed-0: Zombie Uprising” Patch Notes Version 0.5.0（June 7th, 2022）
Hello,
We have started distributing the latest update patch to add new elements, fix the following bugs, and improve the stability of the gameplay.
When this patch is applied, the version on the upper right of the title screen will be 0.5.0.
Added Stage 4 “Tengu” to the main quest
Added “Forsake” “Turnover” “Coming Through” “Battle Prep” to the Blessings of the Sacred Tree
Released the sixth slot of the Blessings of the Sacred Tree
Added new items “Nourishing Pill” “Mind's Eye Charm” “Protection Talisman” “Clairvoyant Talisman”
Added new Secret Arts “Heat Haze” “Deadly Tackle” “Slapdown”
Added “Additional Attack” to one of the enhancements when the Secret Arts are to be strengthened
Added a "Step Strike" that can be performed by pressing the normal attack button while "Raiden" is in the middle of a step
Added a new Torii Gate “Item Torii Gate”
Added a new abnormal status “Water-splashed”

Changed the operation to generate an additional effect with the strong attack of "Raiden": [Before change] Press and hold the button and accumulate to the maximum: [After change] Press and hold the button and release it at the right moment
Removed some “Secret Arts”
Modified the effects of some “Secret Arts”
Modified the effects of some “Charms”
Modified some of the enhancements when the Secret Arts are to be strengthened
Changed the color of “Homecoming Torii Gate” to white
Removed the “Fortune-telling Torii Gate”
Modified so that items on the ground can be stored directly in the wicker box
Modified to prevent shopkeepers from becoming targets of bullet attacks of some charms
Adjusted the overall combat balance
Fixed some issues that could cause the game to crash
Fixed a bug in which the next floor movement effect occurred twice when entering a different colored Torii Gate
Fixed a bug that caused to lose control when using food or items directly from the ground

Fixed other minor bugs: We will continue to update additional elements and make balance adjustments as part of the process of polishing the game, and we really appreciate your continued support and cooperation!!: Team Ed-Zero: Tell us about the game in the official Discord! https://discord.gg/4dMMPXqKV3

We have started distributing a patch as the second minor update to fix the following bugs and improve the stability of the gameplay.
When this patch is applied, the version on the upper right of the title screen will be 0.4.2.
-Modified so that traps will not be activated when stepping on them in a defensive stance
-Modified so that the item “Water” can be used to remove the flame effect of the “Blazers”
-Modified so that the effect of breaking the items “Water” and “Sake” will be applied to a wider area
-Modified to be able to extinguish “Ablaze” by breaking the item “Water”
-Modified description texts for items and secret arts
-Modified so that breakable objects can be destroyed by step movement
-Modified so that zombies react to the sound of things breaking
-Modified the throwing motion of the “Scavengers”
-Adjusted so that “un-appraised items” do not appear in stages 1-3
-Adjusted the rediscovery behavior after an enemy loses sight of the player
-Modified the achievement unlock notification to a dedicated window
-Modified the UI of the settings screen
-Adjusted overall combat balance
-Adjusted overall quest difficulty
-Added key bind function in options
-Added new Torii Gate in the Sacred Tree Realm to allow the game to be interrupted and saved
-Added camera distance option
-Fixed a bug where the player would not be able to recover from being hit after taking damage during the secret art “Ground Shaker”
-Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck after canceling the secret art “Iai”
-Fixed a bug that could cause inoperability when taking damage at the start of ZEN Mode
-Fixed a bug that caused inoperability when passing through the Torii Gate at the same time you die
-Fixed a bug that caused inoperability when landing during the secret art “Rigid Throw”
-Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when operating the wicker box
-Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when applying the Sumo Wrestler’s button hold strong attack
-Fixed a bug that caused a series of hunger notification to be displayed when equipping the “Fulfilling Charm”
-Fixed a bug that prevented attacks to the body of the “Steam-Powered Giant” when it’s down
-Fixed a bug that caused the “Steam-Powered Giant” to get stuck in the sub-quest “Tower of Training”
-Modified so that zombies called by the "Steam-Powered Giant" are not affected by the charms equipped by the "Steam-Powered Giant”
-Fixed a bug around the display of un-lock conditions for the achievement “Lightning Speed”
-Modified so that the item available in the 3 items selection event cannot be picked up from the item menu
-Fixed a bug that prevented sorting in controller preset 3
-Fixed behavior when an enemy loses sight of the player
-Fixed a bug where enemies were not aware of other sounds while being guided to the location where the sound was made
-Fixed a bug that sometimes caused “Scavengers” to stop acting
-Modified to force return after a player has been in a ragdoll state for a while
-Fixed a bug in which equipping more than one "Fulfilling Charm" would restore Fullness
-Fixed a bug that caused enemies to be placed in a walled-in position
-Modified so that when the maximum Vitality is increased, the current Vitality will also be increased
-Fixed a bug in the sub-quest "On an Empty Stomach" that reflected the effects of the dojo
-Fixed a bug where the sound of "assassination" could be heard by surrounding enemies
We will continue to update additional elements and make balance adjustments as part of the process of polishing the game, and we really appreciate your continued support and cooperation!!
Team Ed-Zero

We have started distributing a patch as a minor update to fix the following bugs and improve the stability of the gameplay. When this patch is applied, the version on the upper right of the title screen will be 0.4.1.
・Fixed a bug where the Money/Virtue in the upper right hand corner of the HUD did not count up properly when playing the game over 110 FPS.
・Fixed an issue where skill panel button displays were reversed.
・Fixed an issue where Torii Gate were not always placed on the floor.
・Fixed an issue where intoxication could occur even during the floor event "You feel less likely to get drunk".
・Fixed a bug where "Spicy Rice Ball" not exploding when thrown.
・Fixed an issue where abnormality resistance was also affecting abnormality accumulation value reduction.
・Fixed an issue where items could be purchased even when the number of items in possession was maxed out.
・Fixed a bug where items were automatically used when they were taken out from the wicker box.
・Fixed a bug that caused the remaining stacked items to disappear when stacked items were used from within the wicker box.
・Fixed an issue of multiple items on the ground.
・Fixed a bug in which the dedication screen of the Manual of Secret Arts was not compatible with mouse operation.
・Fixed a bug that prevented keyboard and mouse operation in the Hokusai Studio.
・Fixed a bug which the sub-quest "On An Empty Stomach" wasn’t working properly.
・Corrected an incorrect description of the value that is a condition for the blessing "Lightning Speed" in the blessing menu of the Sacred Tree.
・Fixed an issue where Fallen Samurai guarding while paralyzed.
・Fixed a bug where objects on the floor blocked the entrance and made it impossible to pass through.
・Fixed an issue where volume changes were not being applied to background music during quests.
・Fixed a bug in which the Vitality of stage 3 boss was not reflected correctly.
・Fixed to be able to control the mouse in the Sacred Tree Blessing screen.
・Fixed an issue where the camera would roll into the ground when your character went down.
・Corrected a translation error in the Sacred Tree Blessing screen.
・Adjusted the number of bombs from trapped treasure chests from 20 to 10.
・Adjusted effects caused by the "Instant Karma Charm" and others.
・Corrected key assignments for moving item slots in the lower left corner of the HUD to Z and V.
・Balanced the calculation of the "Frenzy Charm".
・Modified to show mouse cursor in options when departing from “Kuku Village”.
・Decreased the speed of the Giant crawling state.
・Added “Iron Skin” to the strong attack of Samurai.
・Tweaked the enemy strength in the early levels of Stage 1.
・Modified to not reset the amount of money in one's possession when departing on a quest.
・Adjustment to make surrounding zombies flinch when you guard with perfect timing.
・Adjusted hunger speed slightly slower.
・Adjusted to increase Fullness when eating the Sacred Tree Nut.
・Adjusted the number of traps placed in some stages.
・Adjusted the sound volume control for storytelling scenes.
・Modified so that the item "Homecoming Talisman" does not appear un-appraised.
・Modified so that the cool time is not consumed when a secret art is stopped from enemy attacks.
・Reduced the gap in the normal attack of the Samurai.
・Strengthened the Samurai and Sumo Wrestler’s jump strong attacks.
・Adjusted damage intervals for steam gimmicks in the "Kahouin Temple" stage.
・Added new item “Vision Herbs”.
・Added a caution note to the effect that save data will be overwritten when NEW GAME is being selected.
・When you hold the Samurai’s strong attack to the maximum and press the strong attack button again at the right moment immediately after it hits the enemies, a follow-up thrust will be made.

・When the Samurai jumps on the spot 10 times in front of the Azumaya Pavilion in Kuku Village, he can switch with the Sumo Wrestler. If you want to switch back, do the same thing again, this time with the Sumo Wrestler.
We will continue to update additional elements and make balance adjustments as part of the process of polishing the game, and we really appreciate your continued support and cooperation!!
